jobs.name: Fleet Compliance & Blueprint Audit
jobs.prompt: Run the daily fleet compliance and blueprint audit. Read the SOP at 'governance/compliance_audit_sop.md' in your profile home — all 171 lines of it, before you run anything. Its ten checks are section 3, lines 60-142, so a read that stops early skips almost the entire audit and reports a clean fleet it never looked at. Then execute it exactly, using the fleet-audit skill to open and close the audit run.
